caption: The drawing features a single wooden bucket placed against a plain, light beige background. The bucket is cylindrical with vertical wooden slats, alternating in lighter and darker brown tones. It is bound at the top and bottom by two horizontal black bands. Attached to the upper section of the bucket are two small black metal brackets, which support a curved metal handle. The handle arches above the bucket and is fitted with a rounded, brown wooden grip at its peak. The wood grain on both the bucket and the handle is distinctly visible. There is a small signature in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Shaker Wooden Bucket
